claim: For every positive finite k and every fixed distinct labeled start tuple on a circle, an explicit absolutely convergent joint Laplace transform with coefficients expressed as finite sums of specified deterministic integrals of summed one-dimensional exit kernels; both IID-uniform and equidistant source models follow. Uniform outer degree-M remainder theta_max^(M+1)/(M+1)!. Compact simplex support identifies the full law.
model: Independent Brownian walkers with common generator one-half arclength Laplacian, continued through encounters and previously visited territory. Circle circumference normalized to one; multiply lengths by circumference for other circles.
boundary_cases: all equal or zero transform variables
singleton remaining query target represents both interval endpoints
query diagonals and seed coincidences excluded only as null sets in spatial/start integrals
almost-everywhere tie convention; no absence of all pointwise ties asserted
success_criterion: No unknown ownership probability, Brownian path integral/expectation, conditional hitting law or equation solution remains in deterministic coefficients; finite-query formulas proved and every interchange justified. Novelty separately assessed before publication.
